responsibility: Implements textual rendering for GCC wide_int values. It provides decimal and hexadecimal printers for wide_int_ref objects, choosing compact host-wide decimal output when values fit and falling back to full-precision hexadecimal formatting otherwise, so dumps, debugging, and diagnostics can consistently display arbitrary-precision integers with explicit signed or unsigned interpretation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the printing routines declared in wide-int-print.h, including decimal and hexadecimal formatting to buffers and FILE streams. Unlike wide-int.cc, it is limited to textual rendering of wide_int values rather than arithmetic or representation mechanics.
